about_short_description.short_description: PNOE enables health professionals to provide science-backed nutrition and training through breath analysis.

product.name: PNOĒ Metabolic Analyzer
product.description: A clinical-grade device that performs a 10-minute non-invasive breath test measuring 23 biomarkers including VO2 max, resting metabolic rate, fat burn efficiency, and biological age.

product.name: PNOĒ Precision Platform
product.description: A software platform that integrates breath analysis data with other biometric inputs to generate personalized nutrition, training, and bio-optimization plans.

product.name: PNOĒ Precision App
product.description: A mobile application that allows clients to track activity, nutrition, recovery, and access personalized health plans prescribed by practitioners.

product.name: PNOĒ Metabolic Health Dashboard
product.description: A centralized dashboard for healthcare providers to view and analyze clients’ metabolic and biometric data from multiple sources in real time.

identifier.value: Personalized Program Development and Monitoring Service

product.name: Personalized Program Development and Monitoring Service
product.description: A service where registered dietitians and trainers create and monitor customized nutrition, training, and bio-optimization plans based on clients’ metabolic data.
